newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish T-bill secondary trade up 9.63 pct in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Polish T-bill secondary trade up 9.63 pct in Nov.

text.p: Secondary turnover in Polish T-bills rose to 51.80 billion zlotys in November from 47.26 billion in October, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said November secondary trade in NBP-bills rose 130.85 percent to 16.99 billion zlotys from 7.36 billion in October.
Average T-bill holdings in domestic non-financial client portfolios rose 7.99 percent to 9.03 billion zlotys in November from October's 8.37 billion, the NBP said.
